notes.title: INJECTION - Major Demo Update for Debut Festival 2025
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]INJECTION[/b] has been selected for [b]Debut Festival 2025[/b]![/p][p]To celebrate, we're releasing a [b]major update[/b] to the demo - featuring new content, gameplay refinements and improved visuals, This marks the biggest update to the demo since its original launch.[/p][p]Whether you're returning to dive deeper into the chaos or trying the game for the first time, now is the perfect moment.[/p][p]Stay brutal.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🩸 [b]Changelog - Debut Festival Update[/b][/h3][p][b]50+ fixes, tweaks, and additions.[/b][/p][p]🎯 Combat & Enemies[/p][list][*][p]Added weapon recoil animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Nailgun firing animation[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies won’t cluster in one spot anymore (unless forced)[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies react to grenades, flashbangs, and explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies won’t attack immediately after spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemy AI reacting to empty space[/p][/*][*][p]New “Quick Finish” action: kill right after detection[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies ignore sounds and kills while stunned[/p][/*][*][p]Stun now resets properly[/p][/*][*][p]Stunned enemies become aggressive after recovery[/p][/*][/list][p]💥 Visuals & Effects[/p][list][*][p]Particle systems now have lifespans (performance boost)[/p][/*][*][p]Added particles and debris when breaching doors[/p][/*][*][p]Door debris stays after explosion[/p][/*][*][p]Improved blood splatter on walls[/p][/*][*][p]New adrenaline injection effect[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked hit effects (including turrets)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dash visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Smooth slow-motion at level end[/p][/*][*][p]Visual fixes and brightness adjustments[/p][/*][/list][p]🧠 UI / UX / Game Feel[/p][list][*][p]Better UI/UX polish throughout[/p][/*][*][p]Improved aim assist[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked intro sequence (less text, more impact)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated disclaimer screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for overlapping/misaligned text[/p][/*][*][p]Level end screen scoring fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Better gamepad tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial level can now be replayed[/p][/*][/list][p]📜 Actions & Stats[/p][list][*][p]New “Untouched” action: finish level without taking damage[/p][/*][*][p]New action tracking screen: see all level achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect action/stat tracking[/p][/*][*][p]Improved accuracy stats calculation[/p][/*][/list][p]🚪 World Logic[/p][list][*][p]Doors can now be opened from both sides with correct animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved explosion reactions[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed pathfinding logic[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠 Editor / Tech[/p][list][*][p]Improved level editor stability[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud support fix[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop support (full version only)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Misc. softlock and bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🩸And more...[/p]

notes.title: 💉 INJECTION - New Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]We’ve released an update for the INJECTION demo!
Now it:[/h2]
[h2][list]
[*] It looks better: improved effects, graphics, and atmosphere
[*] It runs smoother: improved performance on all machines
[*] More pain: even more blood, gore, and dismemberment added
[*] Fewer problems: numerous bugs fixed, enemy behavior improved
[/list][/h2]

[h2]It’s still an early version, but closer to our final vision.
Check out the new demo, leave feedback, and if you liked it, add it to your wishlist![/h2]

[h2]🔗[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2134690/INJECTION/]INJECTION[/url][/h2]
